escalation.recommendation: Reconcile after other lanes land (bars_state/hud_state count pins + toc Interface belong to the reconcile wave). Options pass still owns the P5 pot/sob wiring and any scenario picker; C6 consumes ui.design_targets.

patterns.skill_gap: In-client behaviour of everything new is UNCONFIRMED by design (offline only). W6 HP/rage feeds, D7 fixed refund, H5 movement compliance and the P5 UI wiring still need an in-client session or the options pass.
patterns.what_hard: Lua 5.1 caps a function at 200 locals: the engine suite hit the ceiling after the additions, so the new scenario blocks are wrapped in do/end scope blocks rather than top-level locals. Also, my first tiebreak fixture mis-added (S+F=50, not 40) - the failing check caught it before commit.
patterns.what_worked: Hunting write-only fields and no-input shells first made the fix list small and mechanical: 4 event hooks + 3 re-begin resets + 1 drag-save + 1 button label, each pinned by checks that fail without the fix (proven by mutation).
